recipes.name: Candied Pecans
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Set aside.
In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, combine the sugar, water, salt, and vanilla.
Cook at medium-high heat, until the sugar melts and boils rapidly, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the pecans and stir to coat.
Immediately transfer them to the prepared lined tray, spreading them out as much as possible.
Let them cool down completely before transferring them to a container. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month.
